name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russia's 7 Nov barrage hit substations linked to nuclear plants, Kyiv says; Abu Dhabi talks set for 10–11 Nov
state: President Zelenskyy said Russia launched 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles on 7 Nov to black out Ukraine before winter, hitting substations linked to the Rivne and Khmelnytskyi nuclear plants; no reactor damage was reported, and reported casualty counts differ (RFE/RL via Eurasia Review; IBTimes). Ukraine's foreign minister called for an urgent IAEA board meeting. It follows the 2 Nov strike on an aid site that killed at least 31 (PBS). US-brokered talks are set for Abu Dhabi on 10–11 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Ukraine and neighbouring areas. Power cuts in Ukraine are likely to continue affecting civilians as winter begins.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on energy grid and nuclear-linked substations (7 Nov); aid-site strike 2 Nov
